mandatoryCriteria: All 32 mounted Stage 2 board, card, discussion, and trash paths conform to FEATURE_SPEC.md, API.md, contracts, and the frozen feature specs.

Board-card cursors are bound to board, normalized filters, and the ordering revision; stale, foreign-board, or changed-filter cursors return 409 STALE_CURSOR without silently omitting or repeating cards.

Card moves validate active destination and canonical adjacent neighbors, reject occupied null/null placement and non-adjacent pairs without side effects, and produce a deterministic collision-free order.
Mounted placement validates that the moving card exists, is active, and belongs to the authorized destination board/project before computing positions.
Overdue search uses workspace-local today and excludes cards whose column category is done.
Card update/move receipt replay and trash serialize on card lifecycle so a stale successful replay cannot occur after trash commits.
Purge is wired to an actual scheduled worker, fences restore against purge in both race orderings, and retries failed object-storage cleanup without losing the storage key or cleanup record.
Deletion redacts retained private comment and notification/activity copies using exact card identity, not substring matching; purged cards retain only allowed tombstone data.
Trash listing is bounded and cursor-paginated; restore re-anchors to surviving neighbors when the original position changes.
All changed contracts, error semantics, runtime wiring and behavior are covered through mounted PostgreSQL routes and applicable Worker checks.
The full selected PostgreSQL check, Worker dry-run build, API tests, contract tests, and focused BRD/CRD/COM/DEL suites pass on the frozen target.
No unresolved hard blocker, category minimum failure, or mandatory acceptance defect remains; only then may any scoped feature be marked verified.
acceptedScope: Full reachable Stage 2 BRD/CRD/COM/DEL feature surfaces, shared authorization/idempotency, PostgreSQL migrations and constraints, mounted routes, Node and Worker wiring, cleanup retries and tests.
knownExclusions: Hosted/deployed behavior and production database verification.
UI rendering, browser workflows, and integrated frontend acceptance.
Dependency advisory status unless a separate online advisory review is explicitly run.
roundNotes: Frozen before round-three source edits. This scope addresses the unresolved round-two acceptance findings and verifies the apparent post-manifest fixes in the current checkout. Round-one and round-two reports remain immutable historical failures.
